card.name: Footnote markers after terms
card.fires_on: Footnote or reference markers (asterisk, superscript digit, lone letter like b or a) attached right after a word or bracketed term. Seen in drug-label tables and dosing text, and in articles and citations.

modes.label: Asterisk after lab term
modes.description: An asterisk follows a measurement name in a dosing criterion, pointing to a footnote.

modes.label: Superscript or letter note
modes.description: A superscript number or single letter sits after a name or list item as a note marker.
modes.example: Phenobarbital, or Primidone<< b>> ) After Discontinuation of Valpro

card.writes: It seems to suppress words about long spans of time, and promotes assorted unrelated tokens, so the output effect is weak.
card.plain: It fires on the small footnote mark, like * or a raised number, placed right after a term.
